name: vscode-release-notes-film
description: The daily VS Code changelog film and its release notes: about a minute on the top ten picks of the changelog report, each change shown in VS Code (recorded, or drawn from a library of 28 scenes) under a Liquid Glass lens, one short line said as it shows, cut on the beat of its theme, reviewed frame by frame; then its GitHub release, with notes an agent writes from the film's kit. Holds the Oct 26, 2026 film whole. Built on the changelog-videos engine. macOS.
